# @stacklatte/chart-core (legacy name)

> Deprecated name, fully supported. It now re-exports `@stacklatte/chart-native` (the React Native / Skia renderer) and, at `@stacklatte/chart-core/core`, `@stacklatte/chart-engine`. New code should install the package it actually needs: React Native → `@stacklatte/chart-native`, web → `@stacklatte/chart-react`, Angular → `@stacklatte/chart-angular`, no UI → `@stacklatte/chart-engine`.

Existing imports keep working unchanged:

```tsx
import { SLChart, calcEMA } from '@stacklatte/chart-core';
import { calcRSI } from '@stacklatte/chart-core/core';
```

Compatibility is tested against the published 2.3.3 (every export still exists; identical numbers). Migration is a find-and-replace of the import path — see https://github.com/Asterix19/charts/blob/main/docs/migrating-from-chart-core.md
